Note that in these tables, verb forms are shown without subject pronouns. In context, subject pronouns are always used in French (except with the imperative,
infinitive, and present participle).
Regular verbs
There are three categories of regular verbs: those ending in -er, those ending in
-re, and those ending in -ir.
